recentItems.title: Charlie Hunnam on Lizzie Borden, New Sons of Anarchy, His Partner’s Support | E! News
recentItems.description:

recentItems.title: Why Whoopi Goldberg Is Taking a Break From The View | E! News
recentItems.description:
Whoopi Goldberg has a sister act-ing role in the works. The 'View' cohost announced alongside the show's executive producer Brian Teta that she will be stepping away from the daytime broadcast so she can work on another project, in which she'll get to flex her acting chops. “We’re going to lose you for a couple of days," Teta said to Goldberg during the Sept. 16 episode of the 'Behind the Table' podcast, "because you’re going to be doing this movie.” And after the 'Sister Act' star confirmed that she would be taking some time away to shoot the forthcoming Netflix film 'Women Like Us'—also starring Jenifer Lewis, Vanessa Williams and Vivica A. Fox—the pair explained how her new schedule would shake out during that time. “You’re going to be gone over the next two weeks but you’ll be here on Mondays," Teta explained. "And the next few weeks, we’re going to have filling in for you, some of our friends, former co-hosts of The View.” Indeed, Lisa Ling, Star Jones, Sherri Shepherd and Debbie Matenopoulos—who all served as cohosts between the late '90s and early 2000s—have all signed on to sit in Goldberg's chair on Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays. Additionally, Joy Behar will moderate the conversations. Full Story: https://www.eonline.com/news/1436213/whoopi-goldberg-leaving-the-view-on-break-for-netflix-film

recentItems.title: Juilliard Apologizes to Julia Stiles Over Dancing With the Stars Shade | E! News
recentItems.description:
Julia Stiles is officially a Juilliard graduate—well, sort of. After the ‘Dancing With the Stars’ contestant called out the school's statement that she never was a student there—despite playing one in 2001's ‘Save the Last Dance’—during an exclusive E! interview, the prestigious conservatory followed up with a hilarious change of heart.  "Dear Julia, with our apologies for the clerical error, your alumni file was found under the name Sarah Johnson," Stiles read from Juilliard's note to her and pro Ezra Sosa in a Sept. 17 TikTok video. "We are so proud of you and cheering you and Ezra on." Full Story: https://www.eonline.com/news/1436211/dancing-with-the-stars-julia-stiles-shares-juilliards-apology-after-shade

recentItems.title: Millie Bobby Brown Welcomes Baby No. 2 With Husband Jake Bongiovi | E! News
recentItems.description:
More than a year after announcing they adopted a baby girl, Millie Bobby Brown and husband Jake Bongiovi have welcomed their second child. Brown, 22, and Bongiovi, 24, shared a photo of their baby boy's hand on Instagram Sept. 17, writing, "hi little guy!" She celebrated her little one with a ring reading "Mom" as well. After adopting her baby girl in 2025, the 22-year-old previously hinted about how she wants to expand her family in the future. While she always hoped to adopt kids, the ‘Stranger Things’ alum noted her outlook on a potential pregnancy down the line. “Hopefully one day that's in my future,” Brown told Kylie Kelce on the June 11 episode of Not Gonna Lie. “But for me, adoption was always a part of my future. Adoption is love. Adoption is forever.” Full Story: https://www.eonline.com/news/1436183/millie-bobby-brown-welcomes-baby-no-2-with-jake-bongiovi

recentItems.title: Kim Kardashian Shares Esophagitis Diagnosis Related to Dad's Cancer | E! News
recentItems.description:
Kim Kardashian is keeping it real about her health. In The Kardashians' season eight trailer, released on Sept. 17, the reality star shared that she has "something called esophagitis." As Kim, 45, was shown laying in a hospital bed, a voice off-camera made a mention of her late father Robert Kardashian, asking, "Isn’t it what he died of?" which Kim confirmed. Esophagitis is the swelling and irritation of tissues lining the esophagus, according to Johns Hopkins Medicine. If left untreated, esophagitis may develop into a condition called Barrett’s esophagus, increasing the risk of esophageal cancer. Robert—also dad to Kourtney Kardashian, Khloe Kardashian and Rob Kardashian with Kris Jenner—died of esophageal cancer in 2003 at age 59. "My dad died really quickly," Khloe shared in an April 2025 episode of her Khloe in Wonder Land podcast. "He had esophageal cancer and I think he died six or seven weeks after diagnosis." The 'Good American' founder continued, "I don't think he could accept himself that it was terminal, but he never used those words with us." recentItems.description:

recentItems.title: Miley Cyrus Reveals Her One Fear About Marrying Maxx Morando | E! News
recentItems.description:
What if the ick comes in like a wrecking ball? That's basically what Miley Cyrus asked fiancé Maxx Morando following their engagement in 2025 after six years of dating. "We've been together six years, and I've never gotten the ick," the Hannah Montana star told Zane Lowe in an interview shared by Apple Music Sept. 17. "All of a sudden I got in my head, I was like, ‘Oh my God, we’re about to get married. What if I get the ick?'" And the Liily drummer—who first met Cyrus on a blind date that ultimately turned into wedding planning—had an answer that proved he was already husband material. "I asked him, 'What happens if you get the ick once you’re married?'" the "Wrecking Ball" artist continued. "He’s like, 'You deal with it and you move on and you don’t be a baby. The ick is for when you’re in fifth grade.'" Full Story: https://www.eonline.com/news/1436205/miley-cyrus-details-maxx-morando-relationship-dynamic-before-marriage

recentItems.title: Bryan Kohberger’s Family Speaks Out About Filing to Change Guilty Plea | E! News
recentItems.description:
Bryan Kohberger’s family shared their thoughts about his decision to revoke his guilty plea in the 2022 murders of four University of Idaho students. “Our full support of Bryan’s decision to pursue post-conviction relief,” Kohberger’s family said in a statement to ABC, “does not come from a place of disregard.” They emphasized that they don’t want their support "to compound the unimaginable grief the families have borne so courageously,” referencing the loved ones of victims Kaylee Goncalves, 21, Madison Mogen, 21, Xana Kernodle, 20, and Ethan Chapin, 20. “Rather, it comes from our family’s need to see that the complete and unvarnished truth is told,” the statement continued. “Like everyone, we seek answers to all the questions that have been raised, which can only be addressed through a proper trial, as opposed to an improper plea.” Despite confessing to the 2022 murders in 2025 and subsequently receiving four consecutive life sentences as a result of a plea deal, Kohberger filed a petition—known as a motion for post-conviction relief—in the summer of 2026 to withdraw his guilty plea. Full Story: https://www.eonline.com/news/1436188/bryan-kohberger-familys-statement-on-revoking-guilty-plea
